item.title: Lee: "New Mechanism Needed to Share AI Excess Profits" (李 “AI 초과이익 나눌 새 메커니즘 필요”)
item.description:
Lee: "New Mechanism Needed to Share AI Excess Profits" (李 “AI 초과이익 나눌 새 메커니즘 필요”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated in an interview with the British economic weekly The Economist, published on the 10th, that a new mechanism is necessary to return a portion of excess profits generated by artificial intelligence (AI) to the public. The Economist reported that President Lee said a new mechanism, such as a basic income, is needed "to distribute a portion of excess profits to the general public." (이재명 대통령은 10일 공개된 영국 경제 주간지 이코노미스트와 한 인터뷰에서 인공지능(AI)으로 창출된 부와 관련해, 초과 이익(excess profits)의 일부를 국민에게 돌려주기 위해서는 새로운 메커니즘이 필요하다고 밝혔다. 이코노미스트는 이 대통령이 “초과 이익의 일부를 일반 대중에게 분배”하기 위해 기본소득과 같은 새로운 메커니즘이 필요하다고 말했다며 이같이 보도했다.)

However, the presidential office said shortly after the report that "it was not a reference to any specific company or issue," adding that "it was a remark about the challenges of the times that we may face in the future to sustain and maintain the capitalist market order during the great transition into the AI era." During a press conference marking his first anniversary in office on the 8th, President Lee said regarding excess tax revenue from the semiconductor boom that "we will make massive investments in areas that the nation must pursue," but regarding the distribution of excess profits, he stated that "it could have a very serious impact on national industrial policy" and that "we must approach it cautiously." <<> In the interview, President Lee said about the agreement to increase defense spending to 3.5% of GDP during security negotiations with U.S. President Donald Trump that "we must take responsibility for defending our country ourselves." Regarding the South Korea-U.S. negotiations discussing the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines and the securing of rights for uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing for nuclear power generation, he said that "South Korea's own nuclear armament is neither desirable nor realistic." On the situation on the Korean Peninsula, he said that President Trump's "unique personality" could "be very helpful" under the current circumstances. <<> Meanwhile, The Economist pointed out that more than half of South Korea's presidents since democratization have experienced impeachment or imprisonment, and assessed that President Lee's own future is uncertain, as he faces trials in five cases including the Daejang-dong and North Korea remittance scandals. In response, President Lee said that the possibility of him also becoming a victim of this vicious cycle is "quite high." <<> The Economist noted that there are reasons for President Lee to be confident, such as his high approval ratings, but assessed that his remark that "South Korea could develop into a world-leading country" was somewhat unconvincing. (다만 청와대는 보도 직후 “특정 기업이나 사안에 대한 언급이 아니다”라며 “AI 시대로의 대전환 과정에서 자본주의 시장 질서의 지속과 유지를 위해 언젠가 직면할 수 있는 시대적 과제에 대해 한 말”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 반도체 호황으로 인한 초과 세수와 관련해 “국가적으로 꼭 해야 하는 영역에 대대적인 투자를 감행할 것”이라고 했지만, 초과 이윤 배분에 대해서는 “국가 산업 정책에 매우 심각한 영향을 미칠 수 있다”며 “신중하게 접근해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Opposition Spokesperson Who Likened Lee to Yoon Resigns After Just One Day Amid Controversy (“누굴 찍어서 당대표로” 李를 尹에 빗댄 與대변인… 논란 일자 하루만에 사퇴)
item.description:
Opposition Spokesperson Who Likened Lee to Yoon Resigns After Just One Day Amid Controversy (“누굴 찍어서 당대표로” 李를 尹에 빗댄 與대변인… 논란 일자 하루만에 사퇴)

Lee Ji-eun, a spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, resigned from her position after sparking controversy by comparing President Lee Jae-myung to former President Yoon Suk-yeol. (더불어민주당 이지은 대변인이 이재명 대통령을 윤석열 전 대통령에 빗대는 발언을 해 논란이 되자 대변인직을 사퇴했다.)

On the night of the 9th, Lee appeared on the pro-government YouTube channel 'Park Si-young TV' and said, "When we looked at Yoon Suk-yeol, we harshly criticized him for picking someone to make them party leader. But now, President (Lee Jae-myung) is doing this? I thought, surely not." (이 대변인은 지난 9일 밤 친여 유튜브 ‘박시영TV’에 출연해 “우리가 윤석열을 보면서 윤석열이 누구 찍어서 당대표를 시키고 (할 때) 엄청 욕을 했었다”며 “그런데 (이재명) 대통령이 지금 이걸 하시는 건가, 설마 하는 생각이 들었다”고 말했다.)

The comment came during a conversation among the panelists about Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who is seeking re-election as party leader, missing a morning airport send-off for President Lee's European tour. Another party leadership contender, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, was present at the airport. Lee implied that just as former President Yoon had pushed out then-People Power Party leader Lee Jun-seok early in his term to bolster Representative Kim Ki-hyun, President Lee might be backing a specific candidate ahead of the party leadership election in August. (당대표 연임 도전에 나서는 정청래 대표가 이날 아침 이 대통령의 유럽 순방길 공항 환송 행사에 못 간 것을 두고 출연자들 간 대화를 주고받다 나온 발언이었다. 공항엔 또 다른 당권주자인 김민석 국무총리는 나갔다. 이 대변인은 윤 전 대통령이 집권 초반 이준석 당시 국민의힘 대표를 밀어내고 김기현 대표에게 힘을 실어줬는데 이 대통령도 8월 당대표 선거를 앞두고 특정 후보를 미는 것 아니냐는 말을 한 것이다.)

Shortly after the broadcast, pro-government communities were flooded with criticism, such as "Is this really a Democratic Party spokesperson?" "This is unacceptable," and "Resign." Notably, pro-Lee supporters emphasized that Lee is aligned with the pro-Jeong faction. Lee, a former police officer, serves as the chair of the Mapo-gu district (constituency A) adjacent to Representative Jeong's district (Mapo-gu B) and was appointed as a spokesperson under Jeong's leadership. (이 방송 직후 친여 커뮤니티에선 “민주당 대변인이 맞느냐” “해당 행위” “사퇴하라” 등의 공격이 쏟아졌다. 특히 친명 지지자들은 이 대변인이 친청계라는 점을 강조했다. 경찰 출신인 이 대변인은 정 대표 지역구(서울 마포을)의 옆 지역구인 마포갑 지역위원장을 맡고 있고, 정청래 지도부에서 대변인으로 임명됐다.)

As the controversy escalated, the Democratic Party leadership reportedly engaged in heated debates over Lee's remarks during a closed-door meeting on the 10th. Pro-Lee supreme council members were said to have reacted strongly, asking, "How could she say such a thing?" and "I couldn't believe my ears." Shortly after, Lee resigned as a spokesperson. In a statement, she explained, "What I meant was, 'We criticized Yoon so much, and now our president is doing the same? Surely that can't be right,'" but added, "I didn't have to mention Yoon by name in the analogy. Regardless of my intent, if I failed to convey it properly and caused a burden to the party, it reflects my inadequacy as a spokesperson." (논란이 커지자 민주당 지도부는 10일 비공개 회의에서 이 대변인 발언을 두고 설전을 벌였다고 한다. 친명계 최고위원들은 “어떻게 이런 말을 할 수 있느냐” “귀를 의심했다”며 반발한 것으로 알려졌다. 이 직후 이 대변인은 대변인직을 사퇴했다. 그는 입장문을 내고 “‘우리가 윤석열을 그렇게 욕했는데, 우리 대통령이 그렇게 하신다고? 설마 그럴 리 없다’는 취지의 말”이라면서도 “굳이 비유의 대상에 윤석열이라는 이름을 올릴 필요는 없었다. 진의가 무엇이었든 간에 제대로 전달하지 못해 당에 부담을 줬다면 대변인으로서의 역량 부족”이라고 했다.)

However, some within the Democratic Party, particularly the pro-Jeong faction, argued, "This is something a politician could easily say; did it really warrant resignation?" One party lawmaker commented, "If we weren't approaching the party convention, I don't think this comment would have been so controversial." (그러나 친청계 등 민주당 일각에선 “정치인으로서 충분히 할 수 있는 얘기인데 사퇴까지 할 일이냐”는 말도 나왔다. 민주당 한 의원은 “전당대회를 앞두고 있지 않았다면 이렇게까지 논란이 될만한 발언은 아니라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Pressure to Abandon Pro-Lee Faction's Re-election Bid... Jeong Cheong-rae: "The People Are Eternal, The Regime Is Short" (친명 연임 포기 압박에… 정청래 “국민은 영원, 정권은 짧다”)
item.description:
Pressure to Abandon Pro-Lee Faction's Re-election Bid... Jeong Cheong-rae: "The People Are Eternal, The Regime Is Short" (친명 연임 포기 압박에… 정청래 “국민은 영원, 정권은 짧다”)

At the first public Supreme Council meeting following the June 3 local elections, Democratic Party of Korea leader Jeong Cheong-rae stated, "I agree with President Lee Jae-myung's evaluation and understanding of the elections," adding, "We will reflect on what needs to be reflected upon." However, pro-Lee faction Supreme Council members mentioned the issue of accountability directly in front of Leader Jeong. In response, near the end of the meeting, he made remarks such as "The people are eternal, and the regime is short" and "The era of factional bosses is over." The pro-Lee faction criticized Jeong for these comments, calling them "inappropriate." A Democratic Party official commented, "With the August party convention approaching, it feels like the simmering conflict between the Myeong (Lee) and Cheong (Jeong) factions is rising to the surface." <<> During the meeting, Leader Jeong stated, "The Democratic Party will examine the public sentiment confirmed in the elections from multiple angles with greater humility and a lower posture," and, "We will heed the criticism and reprimands revealed during the election process, filling in what is lacking and refining what needs to be refined." Earlier, on the 4th, Jeong had said, "I deeply thank the people for granting us a great nationwide victory. However, I am pained that we failed to reclaim Seoul." Shortly after, the issue of Jeong Cheong-rae's responsibility arose within the party. Notably, President Lee Jae-myung, during a press conference marking his first anniversary in office on the 8th, stated, "Losing a place we should have won makes the problem different," calling it "a warning from the people." A party official noted, "Leader Jeong eventually bowed his head." <<> However, pro-Lee faction Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon, speaking directly in front of Leader Jeong, effectively demanded that he not run for party leader again. Supreme Council member Hwang stated, "The leadership failed to achieve victory in these local elections, which we should have won overwhelmingly," and said, "Fully aware of the responsibility, I will not run in the party convention." Supreme Council member Lee Un-ju also recently stepped down from her position for the same reason. Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu also pressured Leader Jeong, saying, "All of the leadership must take the President's words seriously." <<> Pro-Jeong faction Supreme Council members refuted these points. Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok defended Leader Jeong, saying, "It's easy to criticize, but I hope you recognize that the anguish of those who remain silent is heavier." Supreme Council member Park Gyu-hwan also stated, "It is not desirable for some to distort facts, criticize the nomination process, denigrate the election results, or mock comrades." <<> Afterwards, in his closing remarks, Leader Jeong said, "The public's mind is the mind of heaven. The people are heaven. No regime can defy the people." He added, "Ending the era of factional bosses and parachute nominations was the political reform of the Roh Moo-hyun era, which led to the era of one person, one vote and party member sovereignty." Within the pro-Lee faction, there were comments regarding Jeong's remark, "The regime is short," questioning, "Didn't Leader Jeong just reveal his true feelings towards the pro-Lee faction?" Pro-Lee core member Rep. Moon Jin-seok posted on Facebook, "As the language of the ruling party leader, it is highly inappropriate," and added, "I am very concerned about our party's future." The presidential office commented on Leader Jeong's remarks, stating, "Directly commenting on matters concerning the National Assembly and party affairs is not appropriate." <<> Amidst this, Leader Jeong and Rep. Kim Min-seok, who are competing for party leadership, met and embraced at the ceremony marking the 100th anniversary of the June 10 Independence Movement held at Gwanghwamun Square in Seoul on this day. Democratic Party officials remarked, "We are curious what Leader Jeong, who is facing pressure to resign, was thinking as he embraced Rep. Kim, who is backed by the President and the pro-Lee faction." <<> The Democratic Party appears to be seeing a deepening conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Jeong factions over the issue of Jeong Cheong-rae's accountability, intertwined with the upcoming party leadership race. The More Democratic National Innovation Council, a pro-Lee faction extra-parliamentary organization, stated in a commentary on this day, "We lost an election we should have won," and "The leadership must take responsibility by serving in the ranks as a common soldier." Rep. Park Ji-won appeared on a radio program and said, "Leader Jeong Cheong-rae and the rest of the leadership, even if they feel wronged, must all resign and declare they will not run in the party convention." <<> A debate also erupted over the 'one delegate, one voting party member, one vote' system implemented under Leader Jeong's leadership. The pro-Lee faction argues that Leader Jeong changed this system to secure his re-election as party leader, given his strong support base among party members, and is pushing for supplementary measures. This system will be applied for the first time at the August party convention, and many analysts believe it will benefit Leader Jeong. However, it was reported that during a closed-door leadership meeting on this day, with a pro-Lee faction Supreme Council member absent, an agenda item was passed under Leader Jeong's initiative to expand the one-person-one-vote system--originally applied only to elections for party leader and Supreme Council members--to elections for city and provincial party chapter leaders. (더불어민주당 정청래 대표는 6·3 지방선거 후 첫 공개 최고위원 회의에서 “이재명 대통령의 선거에 대한 평가와 인식에 공감한다”며 “반성할 것은 반성하겠다”고 말했다. 하지만 친명계 최고위원들이 정 대표 면전에서 책임론을 언급했다. 그러자 정 대표는 회의 말미에 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다” “계파 보스 시대는 마감했다” 등의 발언을 했다. 이를 두고도 친명계는 “부적절하다”며 정 대표를 비판했다. 민주당 관계자는 “8월 전당대회를 앞두고 가라앉아 있던 명·청 갈등 조짐이 수면 위로 올라오는 느낌”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "No Manual for Who Delivers Insufficient Ballots" — Election Commission's 6-Hour Delayed Response (“부족한 투표지 누가 전할지 매뉴얼 없다” 선관위, 6시간 늑장 대응)
item.description:
"No Manual for Who Delivers Insufficient Ballots" — Election Commission's 6-Hour Delayed Response (“부족한 투표지 누가 전할지 매뉴얼 없다” 선관위, 6시간 늑장 대응)

The root cause of the ballot shortage on the 3rd is being revealed as a systemic failure across all levels of the National Election Commission (NEC). The NEC has city/province and city/county/district organizations under its central body, and issues arose at every tier. The case of Seoul's Songpa District, the epicenter of the ballot shortage, exemplifies this. On the 10th, the Central NEC’s fact-finding committee stated at its first meeting that there was no response manual during the ballot shortage. (지난 3일 투표용지 부족 사태의 원인이 선거관리위원회의 총체적 부실 때문이라는 점이 드러나고 있다. 선관위는 중앙선관위 산하에 시·도, 시·군·구 조직을 갖추고 있는데, 모든 레벨에서 문제가 발생했다. 투표용지 부족 사태의 진원지 격인 서울 송파구 사례가 대표적이다. 중앙선관위 진상규명위원회는 10일 첫 회의를 통해 투표용지 부족 당시 선관위 대응 매뉴얼이 없었다고 밝혔다.)

The Central NEC set the policy on how many ballots to print for the June 3 local elections in December last year, six months before the vote. It decided to reduce the ballot printing ratio from a minimum of 60% of eligible voters to 50%. This was due to rising early voting rates, difficulties in storing ballots, and concerns that excessive leftover ballots could fuel allegations of election fraud. (중앙선관위가 6·3 지방선거 당일 투표용지를 얼마나 찍을지 방침을 정한 것은 선거 6개월 전인 작년 12월이었다. 선관위는 유권자 대비 최소 60% 찍던 본투표 용지 인쇄율 기준을 50%로 축소하기로 결정했다. 사전투표율 증가와 투표용지 보관의 어려움, 투표용지가 많이 남을 경우 부정선거 의혹이 제기된다는 이유였다.)

However, this decision was made not by the nine Central NEC commissioners but by Heo Cheol-hoon, the NEC Secretary-General, who holds a ministerial-level rank, through his sole authority. It was reported that no separate meeting was held by Wi Cheol-hwan, a standing commissioner appointed by President Lee Jae-myung last year, or the eight non-standing NEC commissioners. An NEC official stated, “Procedures for ballot printing standards and other voting processes have been determined by the Secretary-General in accordance with regulations.” (그런데 이 결정은 9명의 중앙선관위원이 아니라 장관급인 허철훈 선관위 사무총장이 전결로 정해졌다. 작년 이재명 대통령이 임명한 위철환 상임위원이나 8명의 비상임 선관위원은 별도 회의를 열지 않았다고 한다. 선관위 관계자는 “투표용지 인쇄 기준 등 투표 사무 절차는 규칙에 따라 사무총장이 결정해 왔다”고 했다.)

This decision was passed down as a 'guideline' to 255 city/county/district election commissions nationwide. The Songpa District Election Commission was instructed, “If there is a need to reduce ballot printing, set 50% of eligible voters as the lower limit and calculate it through individual committee resolutions.” The secretariat of the Songpa District Election Commission drafted a 'plan to reduce ballot printing quantities' at the minimum standard of 50% of eligible voters. However, for Jamsil 3 and 4-dong, where early voting rates had been low in the past, 60% was set. (이 결정은 ‘지침’으로 전국 255개 시·군·구 선관위에 내려졌다. 서울 송파구선관위에도 “(투표 용지) 축소 인쇄 필요성이 있을 경우 선거인 수 50%를 하한선으로 잡고 개별 위원회 의결로 산정하라”고 전달됐다. 송파구선관위 사무국은 최저 기준인 유권자 대비 50%를 인쇄하는 ‘투표용지 인쇄 매수 축소 결정안’을 작성했다. 다만 과거 사전투표율이 낮았던 잠실 3·4동은 60%로 정했다.)

The Songpa District Election Commission consists of non-standing commissioners, including judges and figures recommended by the ruling and opposition parties. While most election commissions held meetings to decide printing ratios, the Songpa District Election Commission resolved the secretariat’s draft in writing on May 7. According to reports, the Songpa District Election Commission based its decision on the Songpa District voter turnout from the 2022 presidential and local elections, the 2024 general election, and the 2025 presidential election. (송파구선관위는 판사, 여야가 추천한 인사 등 비상임 위원으로 구성돼 있다. 대부분의 선관위가 선관위원 회의를 열어 인쇄율을 정했지만 송파구선관위는 지난 5월 7일 서면으로 사무국이 작성한 원안을 의결했다. 송파구선관위는 2022년 대선과 지방선거, 2024년 총선, 2025년 대선에서 송파구 투표율을 기준으로 결정했다고 한다.)

Not only Songpa but most city/county/district election commissions determined printing quantities based on the last three to four national elections. However, the voter turnout for the 2022 local elections (50.9%) was lower than that of 2018 (60.2%) or this year’s local elections (61%). It was the second-lowest turnout in the history of local elections. An NEC official said, “Each regional secretariat decides its own printing quantities,” adding, “We regret that the characteristics of each polling station or the early voting rate for this election were not taken into account.” (송파구뿐 아니라 대부분의 시·군·구 선관위는 최근 3~4차례 전국 선거를 근거로 인쇄량을 정했다. 그런데 이 중 2022년 지방선거 투표율(50.9%)은 2018년(60.2%)이나 올해 지방선거(61%)보다 낮았다. 지방선거 기준 역대 둘째로 낮은 투표율이었다. 선관위 관계자는 “각 지역 사무국이 인쇄 매수를 자체적으로 결정한다”며 “각 투표소별 특성이나 이번 선거의 사전투표율 등이 고려되지 않은 것은 아쉽게 생각한다”고 했다.)

In the process of regional election commissions distributing ballots to polling stations under their jurisdiction, 1,371 polling stations nationwide (9.6% of all polling stations) received less than 50% of ballots relative to eligible voters. When ballots were allocated in units of 100, some stations ended up with even fewer. The Songpa District Election Commission decided to print 60% of ballots for Jamsil 4-dong, but at polling station 7 in Jamsil 4-dong, only 44% of ballots were stocked. This station experienced the most severe ballot shortage nationwide. (지역 선관위가 관할 투표소에 투표용지를 보내는 과정에서 전국 1371곳 투표소(전체 투표소의 9.6%)에선 유권자 대비 50% 미만 투표용지가 배부됐다. 투표용지는 100장 단위로 배분하면서 일부 투표소에 더 적게 배부된 것이다. 송파구선관위는 잠실4동에서 유권자의 60% 투표용지를 인쇄하기로 했는데, 잠실4동 7투표소의 경우 유권자의 44%만 투표용지가 비치됐다. 이 투표소는 전국에서 투표용지가 가장 많이 모자랐다.)

Responses at the polling station level were also problematic. At polling station 2 in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa District, it took 6 hours for additional ballots to be delivered. According to the NEC, at 11:40 a.m. on election day, the Songpa District Election Commission, while monitoring real-time voter turnout, inquired with the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission about how to respond to a ballot shortage. At 11:58 a.m., the Ogeum-dong polling station in Songpa asked the Songpa District Election Commission via a group chat about how to handle a ballot shortage. At 1:45 p.m., the Songpa District Election Commission requested the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission to assign serial numbers to 500 unnumbered ballots for additional distribution. (투표소 차원의 대응도 문제였다. 송파구 잠실7동 2투표소의 경우 투표용지가 추가로 이송되기까지 6시간이 걸렸다. 선관위에 따르면 투표일 오전 11시 40분 송파구선관위는 실시간 투표율 모니터링 중 서울시선관위에 투표용지 부족 시 대응과 관련해 문의했다. 오전 11시 58분에는 송파구 오금동 투표소에서 단체대화방을 통해 송파구선관위에 투표용지 부족 시 대처 방안을 문의했다. 오후 1시 45분 송파구선관위는 서울시선관위에 투표용지 추가 투입을 위해 일련번호가 없는 투표용지 500장에 일련번호를 부여해달라고 요청했다.)

The Central NEC formally became aware of the situation at 4:25 p.m., when the election situation room received a complaint call from a voter at polling station 3 in Garak 2-dong about ballot shortages. At 5:00 p.m., the Central NEC instructed the Songpa District Election Commission to assess the quantity of ballots needed and whether additional ones could be received. Ten minutes later, the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission advised the Songpa District Election Commission to collect spare ballots from nearby polling stations within its jurisdiction and transport them. Ballots were dispatched to polling station 2 in Jamsil 7-dong at 6:00 p.m. In total, it took over 6 hours from the time the possibility of a ballot shortage was identified on-site to the response. (중앙선관위가 공식적으로 사태를 인지한 시점은 오후 4시 25분이었다. 선거상황실이 가락2동 3투표소의 투표용지 부족 관련 민원인 전화를 받으면서다. 중앙선관위는 오후 5시 송파구선관위에 투표용지 부족 수량 및 추가 수령 여부 파악을 지시했고, 10분 후 서울시선관위가 송파구선관위에 관내 인근 투표소에 있는 투표용지 여유분을 회수해 이송하라고 안내했다. 잠실7동 2투표소에 투표용지 200매를 보낸 시점은 오후 6시였다. 현장에서 투표용지 부족 가능성을 인지하고 대응까지 6시간 넘게 걸린 셈이다.)

item.description:
PPP's New Floor Leader Elected: Three-Term Lawmaker Jeong Jeom-sik from PK (국힘 원내대표에 PK 3선 정점식)

The People Power Party (PPP) elected its new floor leader on the 10th, with three-term lawmaker Jeong Jeom-sik (representing Tongyeong and Goseong in South Gyeongsang Province) winning the position. Previously classified as part of the broader pro-Yoon faction, Representative Jeong stated in his acceptance speech, "There can be no factions, divisions, or confrontations within our party," and added, "I will never be swayed by the voices of specific individuals or groups." Regarding concerns within the party about becoming a "pro-Yoon party again," he responded, "I take that seriously. I will actively voice opinions in parliamentary operations to dispel such concerns." When asked about the status of Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who lost in the June 3 local elections, he replied, "I will carefully listen to the opinions of lawmakers and proceed accordingly." <<> Representative Jeong was elected after a runoff vote on the same day, securing 55 votes out of 103 PPP lawmakers (out of a total of 110), beating Representative Kim Do-eup, who received 48 votes—a margin of 7 votes. In the first round, Representative Jeong received 47 votes, Kim 39, and Seong Il-jong 20. Inside and outside the party, there were assessments that "in the past, Representative Jeong would have been smoothly elected without a runoff," and that "voices calling for change will grow louder." <<> Representative Jeong, a native of Goseong, South Gyeongsang Province, graduated from Seoul National University's College of Law. After passing the 30th bar exam, he served in the prosecution for 25 years, holding positions such as Director of the Public Security Department at the Supreme Prosecutors' Office and Second Deputy Chief Prosecutor at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office. He was first elected in a by-election for the National Assembly in 2019 in Tongyeong and Goseong and has since served three consecutive terms. Within the PPP, he has held key party positions including Secretary-General and Chairman of the Policy Committee. (국민의힘 새 원내대표에 3선의 정점식(경남 통영·고성) 의원이 10일 선출됐다. 과거 범친윤계로 분류됐던 정 원내대표는 이날 당선 소감에서 “우리에겐 계파도 분열도 대립도 있을 수 없다”며 “특정인과 특정 세력의 목소리에 결코 흔들리지 않을 것”이라고 밝혔다. ‘도로 친윤당’이라는 당내 우려에 대해서 그는 “뼈아프게 받아들인다. 그런 부분이 불식될 수 있도록 원내 운영에 적극적으로 의견을 개진하겠다”고 했다. 6·3 지방선거에서 패한 장동혁 대표 거취와 관련한 물음에는 “의원들의 의견을 소중히 듣고 진행해 나가겠다”고 답했다.)

item.title: “Please Help Free Missionaries Detained in North Korea” (“北 억류 선교사 석방 도와달라”)
item.description:
“Please Help Free Missionaries Detained in North Korea” (“北 억류 선교사 석방 도와달라”)

During their visit to South Korea, U.S. Department of State Acting Assistant Secretary for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor Riley Barnes, Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary Julie Turner, and White House Office of Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships Liaison Belcys Romero met with the families of South Korean missionaries who have been detained in North Korea for over a decade. Earlier, on the 21st of last month, Barnes delivered a video message at an international conference held at Yonsei University under the theme “Bring Home the Three South Korean Missionaries Detained in North Korea,” calling for their immediate release. <<> Choi Jin-young, co-representative of the “Family Council for Citizens Detained in North Korea,” stated on the 10th that he met with Acting Assistant Secretary Barnes, Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary Turner, and Liaison Romero in Seoul on the 9th. North Korea currently holds three South Korean missionaries (Kim Jeong-uk, Kim Kuk-ki, and Choi Chun-gil), and Choi is the son of missionary Choi Chun-gil. <<> Choi said that during this meeting, he delivered a letter to U.S. State Department and White House officials requesting that President Donald Trump ask North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un to release the detained South Korean missionaries. He also submitted a petition signed by 10,000 people online and offline, primarily through Korean churches in Los Angeles (LA), calling for the release of the three Korean missionaries. The petition campaign is led by Korean-American missionary Kim Hak-song, who was detained by North Korean authorities in Pyongyang in May 2017 and released a year later when then-Secretary of State Mike Pompeo visited North Korea. <<> North Korea illegally arrested missionary Kim Jeong-uk in October 2013 while he was active in the North Korea-China border area, and later detained missionaries Kim Kuk-ki and Choi Chun-gil in October and December of the following year. The North applied espionage charges against them, sentencing them to “reform through labor for life” (life imprisonment). Since then, it has not disclosed their status to their families or even to UN human rights bodies. North Korea is also detaining South Korean nationals Ko Hyun-chul, Kim Won-ho, Park Jeong-ho, and Ham Jin-woo, who are defectors from the North. <<> Choi also requested that the U.S. side have the U.S. Ambassador to South Korea (or Chargé d’Affaires) attend the upcoming June 28 event marking the Day of Remembrance for Abductees During the Korean War (June 25th), to send a message to North Korea that the U.S. has not forgotten the issue of detained South Korean missionaries. During their visit, Barnes and other officials also visited Busan’s World Mission Church on the 7th, meeting with Pastor Son Hyun-bo’s side—who had held rallies opposing the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol—to hear concerns from South Korea’s Christian community regarding the current government’s push to enact a “comprehensive anti-discrimination law.” (방한 중인 미국 국무부 민주주의·인권·노동국의 라일리 반스 차관보, 줄리 터너 부차관보 대행과 백악관 신앙사무국의 벨시스 로메로 연락관이 북한에 10년 이상 장기 억류 중인 우리 선교사 가족을 면담했다. 반스 차관보는 앞서 지난달 21일 연세대에서 ‘북한 억류 한국 선교사 3인을 집으로’를 주제로 열린 국제회의에도 한국 선교사들의 즉시 석방을 요구하는 영상 축사를 보냈다.)

item.title: [Episode 12] Seongnam Airport Sector C-7: Sprinting Through the Roar ([12화] 성남 공항 C-7 구역 : 굉음 속 질주)
item.description:
[Episode 12] Seongnam Airport Sector C-7: Sprinting Through the Roar ([12화] 성남 공항 C-7 구역 : 굉음 속 질주)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Seongnam Airport in October. The sky visible through the car window was crystal clear, without a single cloud. The more vivid that clarity, the tighter Evan’s jaw became. (10월의 성남 공항. 차창 너머로 보이는 하늘은 구름 한 점 없이 투명했다. 그 청명함이 짙어질수록 에반의 턱이 조여왔다.)

Seongnam Airport is no mere airfield. It is the gateway through which South Korea’s sovereign embarks on his private jet, and the nation’s front door where VIPs from around the world set foot on Korean soil as state guests. On ordinary days, it is a heavily guarded fortress where massive transport planes and reconnaissance aircraft standby behind barbed wire. On this day, however, the site adjacent to the runway—the size of ten soccer fields—was transformed into a festival of cutting-edge weaponry: the Seoul ADEX (Seoul International Aerospace and Defense Industry Exhibition). (성남 공항은 단순한 비행장이 아니다. 대한민국 통치권자가 전용기에 몸을 싣는 관문이자, 전 세계 VIP들이 국빈 자격으로 한국 땅을 밟는 대한민국의 현관이다. 평상시에는 철조망 뒤로 육중한 수송기와 정찰기들이 비상대기하는 삼엄한 요새. 이날만큼은 축구장 열 개 크기 활주로 옆 부지가 첨단 무기들의 축제장, 서울 ADEX(서울 국제 항공우주 및 방위산업 전시회)로 탈바꿈했다.)

Zing. (징—.)

The iPhone vibrated. It was Irina. (아이폰이 진동했다. 이리나였다.)

[Irina: Evan, did you arrive? Check your heart rate.] ([Irina: 에반, 도착했어? 심장 박동수 체크 좀 해봐.])

[Evan: Just arrived. Today’s a day I can’t afford to mess up.] ([Evan: 막 도착. 오늘은 실수하면 안 되는 날이야.])

[Irina: Are you really nervous?] ([Irina: 많이 떨려?])

[Evan: Honestly, I’m a bit tense. The pressure feels different from London.] ([Evan: 솔직히 긴장이 좀 되네. 런던 때랑은 압박감이 달라.])

[Irina: Then take two deep breaths in, and breathe out long. Like, ‘Hooooo—.’ Repeat it two or three times. It works wonders for shaking off fear.] ([Irina: 그럼 숨을 크게 두 번 들이마셨다가, 길게 내뱉어 봐. 후우우- 하고. 두세 번 반복해. 두려움 떨쳐내는 데 직빵이야.])

[Evan: Did you learn some special forces breathing technique?] ([Evan: 무슨 특수부대 호흡법이라도 배운 거야?])

[Irina: No? I saw it on TikTok the other day. They say it was a secret trick Vikings used before battle in the 16th century?] ([Irina: 아니? 얼마 전에 틱톡에서 봤어. 16세기 바이킹들이 전투 전에 썼던 비법이라나?])

[Evan: Irina, there were no Vikings in the 16th century. If you keep watching stuff like that, your brain really will melt.] ([Evan: 이리나, 16세기엔 바이킹이 없었어. 그런 거 계속 보면 진짜 뇌가 녹아버린다니까.])

[Irina: There you go, acting all smart again. Don’t argue, just try it! I’m telling you, it works!] ([Irina: 또 잘난 척하네. 따지지 말고 그냥 해봐! 효과 있다니까?])

Evan felt the corner of his mouth lift. Vikings or no Vikings, Irina’s intuition struck a blind spot in Evan’s algorithm. She was assigned to the VIP security line for foreign guests at ADEX today. The access he couldn’t have was now operating somewhere inside this exhibition hall—through Irina’s feet. (에반은 입꼬리가 올라가는 걸 느꼈다. 바이킹이 있건 없건, 이리나의 직관은 에반의 알고리즘이 놓친 사각지대를 찔렀다. 오늘 그녀는 ADEX 외국 VIP 경호 라인에 투입됐다. 에반은 가질 수 없던 접근권이 지금 이 전시장 안 어딘가에서 작동하고 있었다. 이리나의 발로.)

“Shoop, shoop… Hooooo—" (“쓰읍, 쓰읍… 후우우—")

Pretending not to notice, Evan let out a deep breath following Irina’s advice, opened the taxi door, and stepped onto the asphalt of Seongnam Airport. (짐짓 모른 척 이리나 말대로 깊은 호흡을 내쉬며, 에반은 택시 문을 열고 성남 공항 아스팔트 위로 발을 내디뎠다.)

As soon as he entered the exhibition hall, the roar of fighter jets struck his eardrums. (전시장에 들어서자마자 전투기 굉음이 고막을 때렸다.)

KWA-GWANG—! (쿠과광—!)

A next-generation fighter jet performing a demonstration soared vertically, leaving a long contrail across the sky. Evan’s left index finger scraped his thumbnail twice. A gesture to count his heart rate. (시연 비행 중인 차세대 전투기가 수직으로 솟구치며 하늘에 긴 항적운을 남겼다. 에반의 왼손 검지가 엄지 손톱을 두 번 긁었다. 심박수를 세는 동작이었다.)

Tens of thousands of spectators and suited officials flowed between the booths. Finding a single person among them and pulling off a 30-second pitch was impossible without coordinates. But Evan had coordinates—that’s why he was here. Coordinates that leaked from Director Choi’s mouth. (수만 명의 관람객과 정장 차림 관계자들이 부스 사이를 흘러 다녔다. 이 안에서 단 한 명을 찾아 30초의 피칭을 성공시킨다는 건 좌표가 없으면 불가능한 일이었다. 하지만 에반에게는 좌표가 있었기에 이곳에 왔다. 최 상무의 입에서 흘러나온 좌표.)

Tuesday, 10 a.m., Taesan booth. (화요일 오전 10시, 태산 부스.)

He checked his watch. 9:23 a.m. 37 minutes left. (시계를 확인했다. 9시 23분. 37분 남았다.)

Screens flickered at every booth. Defense company employees were repeating the same spiel for the twentieth time, and high-ranking military officials with stars on their shoulders shook hands and posed for commemorative photos amid camera flashes. (부스마다 스크린이 번쩍였다. 방산업체 직원들은 같은 문장을 스무 번째 반복하고 있었고, 별이 몇 개씩 달린 군 고위 관료들은 카메라 플래시 사이로 악수를 나누며 기념사진을 찍었다.)

Evan pushed through the crowd, unfolding the exhibition hall’s layout in his mind. Taesan Defense booth. The center of Hall B, right next to the main stage. The VIP route was a straight line from the Hall A entrance to Hall B. For Chairman Shin to reach the booth for the demonstration, he had to pass through the A-B connecting corridor. (에반은 인파를 헤치며 전시장 배치도를 머릿속에 펼쳤다. 태산디펜스 부스. B홀 중앙, 메인 스테이지 바로 옆. VIP 동선은 A홀 입구에서 B홀까지 일직선. 신 회장이 시연을 위해 부스에 도착하려면 반드시 A-B 연결 통로를 거쳐야 한다.)

As he passed the Dudal booth, a familiar voice popped out from inside. (듀다엘 부스를 지나칠 때, 안에서 낯익은 목소리가 튀어나왔다.)

“Hey, Team Lead Evan. What’s up today? You look ashen.” (“어이, 에반 팀장. 오늘 무슨 일 있어? 얼굴이 아주 흙빛인데.”)

American colleagues from the Technical Sales team sized him up from head to toe near the water cooler. When Evan grabbed a water bottle without answering, the colleague next to him waved a dismissive hand. (기술영업팀 미국인 동료들이 정수기 앞에서 에반을 위아래로 훑었다. 에반이 대답 없이 생수병을 집어 들자, 옆의 직원이 귀찮다는 듯 손을 휘저었다.)

“Why do you keep wandering around? Go deal with some of those people hovering by the entrance. You’re good at Korean. They keep asking weird questions, and we’re busy prepping for real business meetings.” (“어딜 자꾸 그렇게 왔다 갔다 해? 저기 입구에서 기웃거리는 사람들 좀 상대해 줘. 넌 한국말 잘하잖아. 자꾸 이상한 거 물어보는데 우린 진짜 비즈니스 미팅 준비하느라 바쁘거든.”)

Evan drank the water. He wasn’t sorry, but he said he was sorry. (에반은 생수를 마셨다. 미안하지는 않지만, 미안하다고 했다.)

“Jeff was looking for you a while ago. He was grumbling, ‘Sentinel had a meeting with Taesan Defense for over 30 minutes, and what are you doing?’” (“제프가 너 아까부터 계속 찾던데? 센티넬 쪽은 태산디펜스와 30분 넘게 미팅했는데 넌 뭐 하냐고 한 소리 하더라.”)

Hearing the words ‘Sentinel’ and ‘Taesan meeting,’ Evan’s water bottle paused in front of his lips. Thirty minutes meant it wasn’t just a courtesy greeting but a working-level discussion. But he recalled the red text from the side table in Shin Jae-hyuk’s office. (센티넬과 태산의 미팅이라는 단어를 듣자, 에반의 생수병이 입술 앞에서 멈췄다. 30분이면 의례적인 인사가 아니라 실무 협의다. 하지만 신재혁 집무실 사이드 테이블에서 본 빨간 글씨를 떠올렸다.)

Sentinel’s card was a blank one. There was still time. Not much, though. (센티넬의 카드는 아직 숫자가 찍히지 않은 카드다. 시간은 있다. 많지는 않지만.)

“If you’re coming tomorrow too, check the VIP lounge reservation list for me.” (“내일도 올 거면 VIP 라운지 예약 리스트나 좀 다시 확인해 줘.”)

Evan tossed the empty bottle into the trash and stepped out of the booth. He had no time to be treated like a translation prop here. (에반은 빈 물병을 쓰레기통에 넣고 부스 밖으로 나왔다. 여기서 통역용 소품 취급이나 당하고 있을 시간이 없었다.)

9:41 a.m. (9시 41분.)

Evan walked toward the A-B connecting corridor. He counted the security personnel. Two on each side of the corridor, one at the intersection. He needed to identify accessible points before the VIP line was locked down. (에반은 A-B 연결 통로를 향해 걸었다. 보안 요원들의 위치를 세었다. 통로 양쪽에 두 명, 교차점에 한 명. VIP 라인이 통제되기 전에 접근 가능한 포인트를 확인해야 했다.)

Just then, his phone vibrated again. (그때, 휴대폰이 다시 진동했다.)

[Irina: Evan, Sentinel’s movements are suspicious. Sentinel personnel are pulling out of the Taesan booth. Looks like they’re prepping for a demo.] ([Irina: 에반, 센티넬 쪽 동향이 수상해. 태산 부스에서 센티넬 인원들이 빠져나가고 있어. 시연 준비하는 분위기야.])

[Irina: But I’ve spotted movement on the VIP security line. Chairman Shin’s escort team seems to have changed their route—not to Hall B, but toward the outdoor Chalet.] ([Irina: 근데 VIP 경호 라인에서 움직임 포착. 신 회장 수행팀이 B홀이 아니라 야외 샬레(Chalet) 쪽으로 동선을 바꾼 것 같아.])

Evan’s steps stopped. Route change. The Chalet, not the Taesan booth. An outdoor VIP reception facility right next to the runway. A premium space set up by the runway. In an instant, the approach route Evan had designed all night became useless. (에반의 걸음이 멈췄다. 동선 변경. 태산 부스가 아니라 샬레. VIP 전용 야외 접견 시설. 활주로 바로 옆에 설치된 프리미엄 공간이다. 에반이 밤새 설계한 접근 루트가 무용지물이 되는 순간이었다.)

[Evan: Which part of the Chalet?] ([Evan: 샬레 어디?])

[Irina: West end of the runway, Sector C-7. The VIP line control just started. You can’t get in through the main gate.] ([Irina: 활주로 서쪽 끝. C-7 구역. 지금 VIP 라인 통제 시작됐어. 정문으로는 못 들어가.])

[Irina: If you loop around through the outdoor exhibition area, you’ll see the rear of the Chalet. About 200 meters from there to the runway boundary. It’s now or never, Evan. Run!] ([Irina: 야외 전시 구역 쪽으로 돌아가면 샬레 후면부가 보일 거야. 거기서 활주로 경계선까지 약 200미터. 지금이야, 에반. 뛰어!])

Evan started running. He shouldered through the crowd moving in the opposite direction. People glanced at the suited man sprinting full-speed, but he had no time to care. Bursting out into the outdoor exhibition area, his view opened up. A three-story-high missile launcher and rows of heavy self-propelled howitzers blocked the view toward the massive runway. (에반은 뛰기 시작했다. 반대 방향으로 움직이는 인파를 어깨로 헤쳤다. 정장 차림에 전력 질주하는 남자를 사람들이 힐끗 돌아봤지만 신경 쓸 여유가 없었다. 야외 전시 구역으로 빠져나오자 시야가 트였다. 3층 높이의 미사일 발사대와 육중한 자주포들이 줄지어 선 모습이 거대한 활주로 쪽을 가리켰다.)

Squeezing through a narrow gap between armored vehicles, he spotted the white tent structure of the Chalet in the distance. And in front of it—Chairman Shin’s back, surrounded by a thick layer of escorts in black suits. (장갑차 사이로 난 좁은 통로를 빠져나가자, 저 멀리 샬레의 흰 천막 구조물이 보였다. 그리고 그 앞—검은 정장을 입은 수행원들에 겹겹이 둘러싸인 신 회장의 뒷모습.)

At that moment, three combat training jets began an airshow overhead, unleashing a deafening roar. (그 순간, 하늘 위로 전투 훈련기 세 대가 에어쇼를 시작하며 굉음을 쏟아냈다.)

GOOOOOO—! (구우우우우—!)

The engine noise slammed into the atmosphere. Evan’s vision narrowed. Tinnitus swelled in his ears. The sound of a wrench dropping on metal echoed from the deepest part of his brain. It was August again. Fallujah again. (엔진 소음이 대기를 강타했다. 에반의 시야가 좁아졌다. 귓속에서 이명이 차올랐다. 금속 위로 떨어지는 렌치 소리가 뇌의 가장 깊은 곳에서 울렸다. 다시 8월이었다. 다시 팔루자였다.)

One second. Two seconds. (1초. 2초.)

Evan’s right hand went into his pocket. His fingers gripped Sariel’s authentication module. The matte black metal dug into his palm. A cold, hard texture. The same weight he’d placed in front of Director Park in the London VIP room. The weight of this module was the weight of everything Evan had designed. A system that judges and executes in 0.5 seconds. A system that never hesitates. (에반의 오른손이 주머니 속으로 갔다. 손가락이 사리엘의 인증 모듈을 감싸 쥐었다. 무광 검정의 금속이 손바닥을 파고들었다. 차갑고 단단한 질감. 런던 VIP룸에서 박 실장 앞에 꺼내놓았던 그 무게. 이 모듈의 무게는 에반이 설계한 모든 것의 무게였다. 0.5초 안에 판단하고 집행하는 시스템. 망설이지 않는 시스템.)

The tinnitus stopped. (이명이 멈췄다.)

Evan ran. 50 meters left. 30 meters. One of Chairman Shin’s escorts turned around. Seeing a suited, sweat-drenched man charging at full speed, he stepped forward to block him. (에반은 달렸다. 남은 거리 50미터. 30미터. 신 회장의 수행원이 뒤를 돌아봤다. 정장 차림에 땀이 배어든 남자가 전력으로 달려오는 것을 보고 한 발짝 앞을 막아섰다.)

“Excuse me, this area is—" (“잠깐만요, 여긴”)

Beyond the shimmering heat haze of the runway, the two men faced each other. (활주로의 아지랑이 너머로, 두 사람이 마주섰다.)

The same mouth that had said in the Pangyo office, “Caution and indecisiveness are different.” The same shoulders that had turned away without any deadline—now facing Evan. (판교 집무실에서 “신중함과 우유부단함은 다릅니다”라고 말했던 그 입. 아무런 데드라인도 없이 등을 돌렸던 그 어깨가, 지금 에반을 향했다.)

Chairman Shin’s thumb brushed once against the tip of his index finger. (신 회장의 엄지가 검지 끝을 한 번 쓸었다.)

The hot blast from the jet engine rippled the air between them. The roar of the fighter jets swallowed every sound. (제트 엔진이 뿜어내는 뜨거운 열기가 두 사람 사이의 공기를 일렁이게 했다. 전투기의 굉음이 모든 소리를 삼켰다.)

item.title: U.S. and Japan reject Russian claim that North Korea’s nuclear issue is a ‘settled matter,’ reaffirm commitment to complete denuclearization of North Korea (美·日 “북핵 ‘종결 사안’이란 러 주장 일축, 北완전한 비핵화 의지 재확인”)
item.description:
U.S. and Japan reject Russian claim that North Korea’s nuclear issue is a ‘settled matter,’ reaffirm commitment to complete denuclearization of North Korea (美·日 “북핵 ‘종결 사안’이란 러 주장 일축, 北완전한 비핵화 의지 재확인”)

The United States and Japan held the Extended Deterrence Dialogue (EDD) in Tokyo on the 8th and 9th of this month, stating that they “discussed China’s rapid and opaque nuclear weapons buildup and dismissed Russia’s claim that North Korea’s pursuit of nuclear weapons is a settled matter.” The two countries reaffirmed their existing stance of pursuing the “complete denuclearization of the DPRK,” and the U.S. also committed to defending Japan by deploying all its defense capabilities. (미국과 일본은 이달 8~9일 도쿄에서 확장 억제 대화(EDD)를 열어 “중국의 급격하고 불투명한 핵무기 증강에 대해 논의했으며, 북한의 핵무기 추구가 이미 종결된 사안이라는 러시아의 주장을 일축했다”고 밝혔다. 양국은 “북한의 완전한 비핵화(complete denuclearization of the DPRK)를 추구한다”는 기존 입장을 재확인했고, 미국 역시 모든 방위 능력을 동원한 일본 방어 의지를 공약했다.)

The two countries made these remarks in a statement released after the conclusion of the EDD. The expression “reaffirmed commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea” was also included in the EDD statement from February, but it draws attention in light of Chinese President Xi Jinping’s recent visit to North Korea. As President Xi visited North Korea on the 8th and 9th without mentioning denuclearization, and as China’s official statement on the North Korea-China summit omitted this content, there were observations that China may have tacitly acknowledged North Korea’s nuclear possession. The inclusion of language rejecting Russia’s stance, which effectively recognizes North Korea’s nuclear possession, in this statement is also interpreted as a move conscious of the strengthening solidarity among North Korea, China, and Russia. (양국은 EDD 종료 후 발표한 성명에서 이같이 밝혔다. ‘북한의 완전한 비핵화에 대한 의지를 재확인했다’는 표현은 지난 2월 EDD 성명에도 포함된 내용이지만, 최근 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북(訪北)과 맞물려 눈길을 끈다. 시 주석이 지난 8~9일 북한을 방문하면서 북한 비핵화를 거론하지 않고 북·중 회담에 대한 중국 측 공식 발표에도 이 내용이 포함되지 않아 북한의 핵 보유를 묵인한 것 아니냐는 관측이 나왔다. 이번 성명에 북한의 핵 보유를 사실상 인정하고 있는 러시아 입장을 일축하는 표현이 담긴 것은 북·중·러 연대 강화를 의식한 것 아니냐는 해석도 나온다.)

Japan urged the U.S. to promote multilateral talks, including arms control dialogues with China and Russia, to enhance transparency. The State Department reported that with the participation of the U.S.-Japan Joint Chiefs of Staff, U.S. Indo-Pacific Command, Strategic Command, and U.S. Forces Japan officials, the two countries’ delegations also conducted simulation exercises. The EDD is a consultative body involving the U.S. Departments of State and Defense and Japan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Defense. Between South Korea and the U.S., there is also the Extended Deterrence Strategy and Consultation Group (EDSCG), in which deputy foreign and defense ministers participate, to strengthen alliance deterrence and discuss robust and effective operational measures for extended deterrence (nuclear umbrella). (일본은 투명성 제고를 위해 미국이 중·러 등과 군비 통제 대화를 포함한 다자(多者) 간 회담을 추진할 것을 촉구했다. 미·일 합동참모본부, 미 인도·태평양사령부, 전략사령부, 주일미군 관계자 등이 참석한 가운데 양국 대표단이 시뮬레이션 훈련도 실시했다고 국무부는 전했다. EDD는 미국의 국무부·국방부, 일본의 외무성·방위성이 각각 참여하는 협의체다. 한미 간에도 외교·국방 차관이 참여하는 확장억제전략협의체(EDSCG)가 있어 동맹의 억제력을 강화하고 확장 억제(핵우산)의 강력하고도 실효성 있는 운용 방안을 논의하고 있다.)

item.title: The ruling party, which pushed for five special counsels in a year, is lukewarm on a 'National Election Commission special counsel' (1년간 5개 특검 밀어붙였던 與, ‘선관위 특검’엔 시큰둥)
item.description:
The ruling party, which pushed for five special counsels in a year, is lukewarm on a 'National Election Commission special counsel' (1년간 5개 특검 밀어붙였던 與, ‘선관위 특검’엔 시큰둥)

The Democratic Party of Korea is showing a passive attitude toward pushing for a special counsel investigation into the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections. Since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the Democratic Party handled three major special counsel bills—the Kim Gun-hee, insurrection, and deceased Marine bills—as its first legislative priority, and later established a standing special counsel and a second comprehensive special counsel. Just before the elections, it also attempted to process a 'manipulated indictment special counsel' related to the president's case. An opposition insider said, "I don't understand why the Democratic Party, which called for special counsels on all sorts of allegations, is taking a defensive stance only regarding the Election Commission incident." (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 관련 특검 추진에 소극적 태도를 보이고 있다. 이재명 정부 출범 이후 민주당은 1호 법안으로 김건희·내란·순직 해병 등 3대 특검법을 처리했고, 이후 상설 특검과 2차 종합 특검까지 출범시켰다. 선거 직전엔 대통령 사건과 관련한 ‘조작기소 특검’도 처리하려 했었다. 야권 관계자는 “온갖 의혹을 특검하자고 했던 민주당이 선관위 사태에서만 방어적인 이유를 모르겠다”고 했다.)

While leaving open the possibility of a special counsel, the Democratic Party maintains the position that "a parliamentary investigation comes first." Representative Jeong Cheong-rae said at a Supreme Council meeting on the 10th, "We will swiftly launch a parliamentary investigation special committee to thoroughly uncover the truth, and we will not neglect truth-finding through a special counsel either." However, he did not mention specific timing for pursuing a special counsel. In this regard, Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun stated, "A parliamentary investigation should precede, and it is customary to later conduct a special counsel." This means they will consider introducing a special counsel if suspicions remain after the parliamentary investigation. <<> Representative Yoon Kun-young also said on SBS Radio the same day, "As People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, if we proceed with a special counsel, it will take dozens of days just for the preparation process," adding, "It is common sense for the joint investigation unit of the police and prosecution to start its probe as soon as possible, and then proceed with a special counsel if anything is lacking." <<> Among the opposition, there is talk that the Democratic Party, which pushed through five special counsels in one year under the Lee Jae-myung administration, is unusually lukewarm about a special counsel for the Election Commission incident. The Democratic Party is also looking to handle a manipulated indictment special counsel, which would grant authority to withdraw the indictment of the president's case, as early as this month. The president has also recently lent support to the push for a special counsel. <<> While being passive about pursuing a special counsel, the Democratic Party has also argued for pursuing constitutional amendments to include the Election Commission under the Board of Audit and Inspection's audit scope. Representative Kim Young-bae, who serves as vice head of the Democratic Party's election system reform task force, said at the TF's first meeting that day, "It is time to redesign the entire system, including constitutional amendments, for a new election management system," and asked, "(The People Power Party should also) actively participate in system reform and constitutional amendments." Chief Deputy Whip Chun Joon-ho also said, "If necessary, including constitutional amendments, we will surely establish an Election Commission system that is under public scrutiny." Currently, the Election Commission, as a constitutionally independent body, is not subject to the Board of Audit and Inspection's oversight. (민주당은 특검 가능성을 열어두면서도 “국정조사가 우선”이라는 입장을 유지하고 있다. 정청래 대표는 10일 최고위원회의에서 “하루빨리 국회 국정조사 특위를 가동해 철저하게 진상을 규명하고, 특검을 통한 진상 규명도 게을리하지 않겠다”고 했다. 다만 구체적인 특검 추진 시기 등에 대해선 언급하지 않았다. 이와 관련, 강준현 수석대변인은 “국정조사가 선행돼야 하고, 이후 특검을 하는 게 관례”라고 했다. 국정조사 이후 의혹이 남으면 특검 도입을 검토하겠다는 것이다.)

item.title: In Incheon and Gwangju/Jeonnam, 'Twin Vote' Results Emerge... "Need to Consider Recount" (인천, 전남광주서 ‘쌍둥이 득표’ 속출... “재개표 검토 필요”)
item.description:
In Incheon and Gwangju/Jeonnam, 'Twin Vote' Results Emerge... "Need to Consider Recount" (인천, 전남광주서 ‘쌍둥이 득표’ 속출... “재개표 검토 필요”)

The Central Election Commission's Fact-Finding Committee, launched to investigate the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, has mentioned the possibility of a recount for the so-called 'twin vote' phenomenon, where candidates received identical early voting tallies in some regions. Committee Chairman Jo Hyeon-uk stated in a phone call with the media on the 10th that "there is a need to review whether a live-streamed recount can be conducted" for areas where twin votes occurred, emphasizing the necessity of a high-intensity investigation. In a phone call with this publication, Chairman Jo added, "However, unless legal disputes such as election invalidation lawsuits or annulment of election lawsuits are filed, there is no legal mechanism to open the ballot boxes and verify, which is regrettable." (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 규명하기 위해 발족한 중앙선거관리위원회 진상규명위원회가 일부 지역에서 후보자 간 사전투표 득표수가 동일하게 나온 이른바 ‘쌍둥이 득표’ 현상에 대해 재개표하는 방안을 거론했다. 조현욱 선관위 진상규명위원장은 10일 언론 통화에서 쌍둥이 득표가 나온 지역에 대해 “생중계 방식으로 재개표를 할 수 있는지 검토해 볼 필요가 있다”며 고강도 조사 필요성을 밝혔다. 조 위원장은 본지 통화에서 “그러나 선거무효소송, 당선무효소송 등 법적 쟁송이 제기되지 않는 한 투표함을 개봉해 확인할 법적 장치가 없어 안타까운 심정이다”라고 말했다.)

Earlier, in the early voting for the Incheon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate-elect Park Chan-dae and People Power Party candidate Yoo Jeong-bok received identical votes in Songdo 1-dong and Songdo 2-dong of Yeonsu-gu, with 3,030 and 1,440 votes each, respectively. In the early voting for the Gwangju-Jeonnam Integrated Special City mayoral election, polling stations where Democratic Party candidate-elect Min Hyeong-bae and People Power Party candidate Lee Jeong-hyun secured the same vote count totaled ten—one in Gwangju and nine in Jeonnam. In response, the People Power Party raised suspicions of vote-rigging, while the Election Commission countered that it was a "coincidence." This has led the Election Commission's Fact-Finding Committee to highlight the need for a recount in these areas. (앞서 인천시장 선거 사전투표에선 박찬대 더불어민주당 당선자와 유정복 국민의힘 후보가 연수구 송도1동과 송도2동에서 각각 3030표, 1440표로 동일한 득표를 했다. 전남광주통합특별시장 사전투표에서도 더불어민주당 민형배 당선자와 국민의힘 이정현 후보가 같은 표를 얻은 투표소가 광주 1곳과 전남 9곳 등 총 10곳으로 집계됐다. 이를 두고 국민의힘에서 개표 조작 의혹을 제기했고, 선관위는 “우연의 일치”라고 반박해 왔다. 이에 선관위 진상규명위가 이들 지역에 대한 재개표 필요성을 밝힌 것이다.)

Meanwhile, it has been confirmed that the 'ballot paper storage box' at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul—where the ballot shortage occurred—was discarded before the court's evidence preservation order. Previously, on the 8th, Kim Jeong-cheol, the Reform Party candidate for Seoul mayor, applied for evidence preservation regarding the ballot paper storage box at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong. The Seoul Eastern District Court accepted the request and notified the preservation order at 5 PM on the 9th. However, the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission stated on the 10th, "The Songpa-gu Election Commission handed over small voting booths collected from each district to a disposal company at noon on the 9th," adding, "When delivering waste items to the visiting company on that date, the ballot paper storage box from that polling station appears to have been handed over as well." The Election Commission described the discarded ballot paper storage box as "an election item that was not legally required to be stored in the first place." (한편, 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어졌던 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소의 ‘투표용지 보관 상자’가 법원의 증거보전 결정 이전에 폐기된 것으로 확인됐다. 앞서 김정철 개혁신당 서울시장 후보는 8일 잠실7동 제2투표소의 투표용지 보관 상자에 대한 증거 보전을 신청했고, 서울동부지법은 이를 받아들여 9일 오후 5시 보전 명령을 통보했다. 그러나 서울시선관위는 10일 “송파구 선관위는 9일 낮 12시에 각 동에서 회수한 소형 기표대 등을 폐기업체에 인계했다”며 “해당 일자에 방문한 업체에 폐기물품을 전달할 때 해당 투표소의 투표용지 보관상자 또한 함께 인계한 것으로 파악된다”고 밝혔다. 선관위는 폐기한 투표용지 보관 상자에 대해 “애초에 법적으로 보관해야 할 의무가 없는 선거 물품”이라고 밝혔다.)

As a result, officials from the Seoul Eastern District Court visited the senior citizens' center at Woosung Apartment, which served as the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, on the afternoon of the 10th. However, they were unable to secure the ballot paper storage box and had to conclude the on-site verification. It was confirmed that Min So-young, chairwoman of the Songpa-gu Election Commission, recently resigned. (이 때문에 서울동부지법 관계자들이 이날 오후 잠실7동 제2투표소였던 우성아파트 경로당을 찾았으나, 투표용지 보관 상자를 확보하지 못 해 현장 검증을 마칠 수밖에 없었다. 민소영 송파구 선거관리위원회 위원장은 최근 사임한 것으로 확인됐다.)

item.title: Jung Jeom-sik's Tasks: Breaking Free from the Pro-Yoon Label, Jang Dong-hyuk's Fate, and Responding to the Withdrawal of Indictment (정점식의 과제… 친윤당 탈피, 장동혁 거취, 공소취소 대응)
item.description:
Jung Jeom-sik's Tasks: Breaking Free from the Pro-Yoon Label, Jang Dong-hyuk's Fate, and Responding to the Withdrawal of Indictment (정점식의 과제… 친윤당 탈피, 장동혁 거취, 공소취소 대응)

With the June 3 local elections ending in a victory for the Democratic Party, the People Power Party has elected its new floor leader, three-term lawmaker Jung Jeom-sik (Constituency: Tongyeong and Goseong, South Gyeongsang Province). On the 10th, Rep. Jung defeated Rep. Kim Do-eup, who received 48 votes, by securing 55 votes in a runoff election during the PPP's floor leader race. (6·3 지방선거가 민주당 승리로 끝난 가운데, 국민의힘의 새 원내대표로 3선의 정점식(경남 통영·고성) 의원이 선출됐다. 정 의원은 10일 국민의힘 원내대표 경선에서 결선 투표까지 간 끝에 55표를 얻어 48표를 받은 김도읍 의원을 꺾었다.)

Rep. Jung was previously classified as a member of the pro-Yoon (pro-Yoon Suk Yeol) faction, but after the martial law incident, he supported a party-level "apology for the martial law." He has also opposed the political comeback of former President Yoon Suk Yeol, known as "Yoon-again." Regarding the political moves of former leader Han Dong-hoon, he has maintained a strongly critical stance. (정 의원은 과거 친윤계로 분류됐지만 계엄 사태 이후 당 차원의 ‘계엄 사과’에 찬성했다. 윤석열 전 대통령의 정치 복귀, 이른바 ‘윤어게인’에도 반대해 왔다. 한동훈 전 대표의 정치 행보에 대해선 강하게 비토하는 입장을 취해왔다.)

Rep. Jung is reported to have received support from lawmakers in the Yeongnam region, centered around Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province. As a result, with the defeat of Rep. Kim Do-eup, who had more vehemently called for an "anti-Jang Dong-hyuk" stance and a "change in the party line," political circles have pointed out that "the PPP lawmakers failed to properly read the public sentiment from the local elections." An opposition source also said, "Incumbent lawmakers who are uneasy about their nominations for the general election two years from now have rallied behind Rep. Jung." (정 의원은 이번에 대구·경북을 중심으로 한 영남권 의원들의 지지를 받은 것으로 전해졌다. 그로 인해 ‘반(反)장동혁’과 ‘당 노선 변화’를 보다 선명하게 부르짖었던 김도읍 의원이 패배하자, 정치권에서는 “국민의힘 뱃지들이 지방선거 민심을 제대로 읽지 못한 것”이란 지적이 나왔다. 야권 관계자는 “2년 뒤 총선 공천이 불안한 현역 의원들이 정 의원 뒤로 모였다”고도 했다.)

However, some analyze that the cohesion of the party's power group, centered around the "pro-Yoon faction," is not what it used to be, as Rep. Jung only secured 55 votes in the runoff. The prevailing outlook is that, over time, a cold assessment of the local elections will act as a centrifugal force. (그러나 정 의원이 결선 투표에서 55표를 확보하는 데 그치는 등 ‘친윤계’를 중심으로 한 당권파의 응집도가 이전 같지 않다는 분석도 있다. 시간이 갈수록 지방선거에 대한 냉정한 평가가 원심력으로 작용할 것이라는 전망이 지배적이다.)

The most urgent task for the new floor leader Jung is to break free from the "back-to-pro-Yoon party" frame. Immediately after his election, he met with reporters and, regarding the "back-to-pro-Yoon party" criticism, said, "I will take it to heart painfully," and added, "As I have repeatedly stated, a faction called pro-Yoon simply does not exist." In his victory speech, he stated, "There can be no factions, no division, and no confrontation within us. There is only one People Power Party that upholds public sentiment," and vowed, "I will never be swayed by the voices of certain forces." (신임 정 원내대표에게 가장 시급한 과제는 ‘도로 친윤당’이라는 프레임에서 벗어나는 것이다. 그는 당선 직후 기자들과 만나 ‘도로 친윤당’이라는 지적에 대해 “뼈 아프게 받아들이겠다”며 “누차 말씀드린 것처럼 친윤이란 계파 자체가 존재하지 않는다”고 했다. 당선 소감에서는 “우리에게 계파도 분열도 대립도 있을 수 없다. 오직 민심을 받드는 하나의 국민의힘만 있을 뿐”이라며 “특정 세력의 목소리에 결코 휘둘리지 않겠다”고 말했다.)

This is also linked to the issue of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's status. Jang's camp maintains the position that the outcomes of the local elections and parliamentary by-elections were a "respectable result." On the other hand, both inside and outside the party, there is a widespread perception that with Jang at the helm, it is difficult to look forward to the 2028 general election, let alone the 2030 presidential election. This has led to calls for "Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation," and the voices are growing louder. Around 20 lawmakers, ranging from newly elected members in the recent by-elections to senior figures and first- and second-term legislators, are openly discussing Jang's need to clarify his position. Rep. Jung is also believed to recognize that "Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership" has reached its limit. An opposition source described this as "a difficult task that floor leader Jung must resolve." (이는 장동혁 대표의 거취 문제와도 연결돼 있다. 장 대표 측은 이번 지방선거와 국회의원 재·보궐선거 결과에 대해 “선방했다”는 입장이다. 반면, 당 안팎에선 장 대표로는 2028년 총선은 물론 2030년 대선을 기약하기 어렵다는 인식이 팽배해 있다. 이는 ‘장동혁 사퇴론’으로 이어졌고 그 목소리가 점점 커지고 있다. 이번 재·보선에서 당선된 의원부터 중진, 초·재선 의원 등 20여 명은 장 대표 거취 표명을 공개적으로 거론하고 있다. 정 원내대표 역시 ‘장동혁 리더십’이 한계에 왔다는 인식을 갖고 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 야권 관계자는 “어려워도 정 원내대표가 풀어내야 하는 숙제”라고 했다.)

Resolving factional conflicts within the party and consolidating conservative capabilities are also tasks assigned to floor leader Jung. At the center of this is the issue of former leader Han Dong-hoon's reinstatement as a party member. During key phases such as the martial law and impeachment, last year's presidential election, and the June 3 local elections, the long-festering conflict between the party's power faction and the pro-Han faction has held the PPP back. (당내 계파 갈등 해결과 보수 역량 결집도 정 원내대표에 주어진 과제다. 그 중심에 한동훈 전 대표의 복당 문제가 있다. 계엄·탄핵, 작년 대선, 6·3 지방선거 등 주요 국면 때마다 곪을 대로 곪은 당권파와 친한계의 대립이 국민의힘의 발목을 잡았다.)

Rep. Jung, who had previously been negative about "Han Dong-hoon's reinstatement," has now shown a forward-looking stance. In a YTN interview immediately after his election, he said, "I think Rep. Han Dong-hoon also forms one pillar of conservatism, so if he expresses his intention to return to the party, it is an issue that requires careful consideration by gathering opinions from lawmakers and party members." This was interpreted as an agreement with the perception both inside and outside the party that expelled former leader Han, Lee Jun-seok (leader of the Reformist Party, who left the PPP), and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon are the next conservative contenders. (그간 ‘한동훈 복당’에 부정적이었던 정 원내대표는 일단 전향적 입장을 내비쳤다. 그는 당선 직후 YTN 인터뷰에서 “한동훈 의원도 보수의 한 축을 형성하고 있는 분이라 생각하기 때문에, 본인이 복당 의사를 밝힌다면 의원들과 당원들의 의견까지 수렴해 심사숙고해야 될 문제”라고 했다. 제명된 한 전 대표와 탈당한 이준석 개혁신당 대표, 오세훈 서울시장 등이 차기 보수 주자라는 당 안팎의 인식에 동의한 것으로 해석됐다.)

Another task before floor leader Jung is to dramatically shift the party's orientation from a "Yeongnam Party" centered on TK (Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province) and PK (Busan and South Gyeongsang Province) to a party aiming for the "middle-ground, metropolitan area, and youth" demographic. Currently, out of the 110 PPP lawmakers, over half—59—are from the Yeongnam region. In contrast, only 20 are from the metropolitan area. (TK(대구경북)·PK(부산경남) 중심의 ‘영남당’으로 머무르는 게 아니라 ‘중수청’(중도·수도권·청년)을 지향하는 정당으로 당의 노선을 확 바꿔야 한다는 과제도 정 원내대표 앞에 놓여 있다. 현재 국민의힘 의원 110명 중 절반 이상인 59명이 영남 지역 의원이다. 반면 수도권 지역 의원은 20명뿐이다.)

Rep. Jung's term as floor leader lasts until June next year, about a year before the 2028 general election, meaning he must inevitably play a role in laying the groundwork for the next parliamentary election. A PPP official said, "Based on securing the support of voters in their 20s and 30s, as confirmed in this local election, floor leader Jung's goal should be to devise policies and a parliamentary strategy targeting the moderate voters." (정 원내대표의 임기는 2028년 총선을 약 1년 앞둔 내년 6월까지로, 다음 국회의원 선거를 위한 주춧돌을 쌓는 역할을 맡을 수밖에 없다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “이번 지방선거에서 확인한 20·30 표심 확보를 토대로 중도층을 겨냥한 정책과 원내 전략을 짜는 게 정 원내대표가 가져야 할 목표”라고 했다.)

Furthermore, within the PPP, there are remarks that "Floor leader Jung is in a situation where he must lead the fight against the ruling party, which has taken control of not only administrative and legislative power but also local power." The Democratic Party, having processed contentious bills such as the three judicial reform bills and the "Yellow Envelope Act" in the first half of the National Assembly, is now pushing for a special counsel investigation into the "withdrawal of indictment" in President Lee Jae-myung's case and follow-up legislation to abolish the prosecution service in the latter half. The PPP has so far been forced to watch the Democratic Party's legislative push due to being outnumbered in seats. (아울러 국민의힘 내에선 “정 원내대표는 행정·입법 권력에 이어 지방 권력까지 다수 가져간 거대 여당에 맞서 대여(對與) 투쟁을 지휘해야 하는 상황”이란 말이 나온다. 민주당은 전반기 국회에서 사법 3법, 노란봉투법 등 쟁점 법안을 처리한 데 이어 후반기 국회에는 이재명 대통령 사건의 ‘공소 취소’ 특검, 검찰청 해체 후속 입법 등을 추진 중이다. 그동안 국민의힘은 의석수에 밀려 민주당의 입법 강행을 지켜볼 수밖에 없었다.)

Other major pending issues include the parliamentary investigation and special counsel triggered by the shortage of ballot papers, and the confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook. Political circles predict that the outcome of the organizational negotiations for the National Assembly, which floor leader Jung will soon have to handle in talks with Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do, will be the first test of his combativeness. In response, floor leader Jung stated, "I will unite our ranks to block the ruling party's unilateral exercise of power." (투표용지 부족 사태로 촉발된 선관위 국정조사와 특검, 한성숙 국무총리 후보자 인사청문회 등도 주요 현안이다. 정치권에선 정 원내대표가 당장에 민주당 한병도 원내대표와 만나 협상하게 될 원(院) 구성의 결과가 그의 투쟁력을 가늠해 볼 첫 시험대가 될 것이라는 전망이 나온다. 이에 대해 정 원내대표는 “단일 대오로 여당의 권력 독주를 막겠다”고 했다.)

Rep. Jung served in key party positions during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, including as a member of the PPP's emergency committee and as chairman of the policy committee. Under the leadership of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, launched in August last year, he served as the second chairman of the policy committee, following Rep. Kim Do-eup. Taking responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections, he resigned from the policy committee chairmanship on the 5th before running in this floor leader election. (정 원내대표는 윤석열 정부 시절 국민의힘 비상대책위원, 정책위의장 등 핵심 당직을 지냈다. 작년 8월 출범한 장동혁 대표 체제에선 김도읍 의원에 이어 두 번째 정책위의장을 맡았다. 6·3 지방선거 패배 책임을 지고 지난 5일 정책위의장 직에서 사퇴했다가 이번 원내대표 선거에 출마했다.)

item.title: Lee's Approval Rating Plummets 9.4%p After Election... "Humbly Accept" (李 지지율, 선거 후 9.4%p 급락… “겸허히 받아들여”)
item.description:
Lee's Approval Rating Plummets 9.4%p After Election... "Humbly Accept" (李 지지율, 선거 후 9.4%p 급락… “겸허히 받아들여”)

Poll results released on the 10th showed that following the June 3 local elections, the approval rating of the People Power Party either narrowly led or closely trailed that of the Democratic Party of Korea within the margin of error. (6·3 지방선거 이후 국민의힘의 정당 지지율이 더불어민주당 지지율을 오차범위 안에서 앞서거나 바짝 따라붙었다는 여론조사 결과가 10일 잇달아 발표됐다.)

According to a survey conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 8th and 9th via wireless ARS (automated response system) with 1,002 adults, the Democratic Party's approval rating stood at 38.6%, a mere 0.5 percentage point difference from the People Power Party's 38.1% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). The gap between the two parties, which was 11.7 percentage points in the previous survey (May 26-27) (Democratic Party 43.3%, People Power Party 31.6%), narrowed sharply in just one week. (한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)가 지난 8~9일 무선 ARS 자동응답방식으로 성인 1002명을 조사해 이날 발표한 결과, 민주당 지지율은 38.6%로 국민의힘(38.1%)과의 격차가 0.5%포인트였다(자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조). 직전 조사(5월 26~27일)에서 11.7%포인트(민주당 43.3%, 국민의힘 31.6%)였던 양당 격차는 한 주 만에 급격히 좁혀졌다.)

KSOI analyzed, "This appears to be influenced by results that fell short of expectations in key battlegrounds, such as the Seoul mayoral election and by-elections for National Assembly seats," adding, "The consolidation of the People Power Party's support base in the final stages of the election may also be partially reflected in evaluations of state affairs." A source from the ruling party stated, "We are also looking into the possibility that the shortage of ballots may have spurred the gathering of conservative voters." (KSOI 는 “서울시장 선거와 국회의원 보궐선거 등 핵심 승부처에서 기대에 미치지 못한 결과가 나온 영향으로 보인다”며 “선거 막판 국민의힘 지지층 결집세가 국정 운영 평가에도 일부 반영된 것으로 볼 수 있다”고 분석했다. 여권 관계자는 “투표지 부족 사태가 보수층 결집을 유도했을 가능성도 살펴보고 있다”고 했다.)

In another survey conducted by JoWon C&I on behalf of Straight News from the 6th to the 8th with 2,000 adults aged 18 and older nationwide, released on the same day, the approval ratings for the Democratic Party and the People Power Party were 40.4% and 41.6%, respectively, with the People Power Party leading the Democratic Party by 1.2 percentage points. (조원씨앤아이가 스트레이트뉴스 의뢰로 지난 6~8일 전국 18세 이상 성인 2000명을 대상으로 실시해 이날 발표한 조사에서도 민주당과 국민의힘 지지율은 각각 40.4%와 41.6%로 국민의힘이 민주당을 1.2%포인트 앞섰다.)

President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for managing state affairs also declined simultaneously. In the KSOI survey, President Lee's positive approval rating fell by 9.4 percentage points from the previous week to 50.4%. The negative rating rose by 10.5 percentage points to 45.7%. This is the first time the gap between positive and negative evaluations of President Lee's job performance has narrowed to within the margin of error. (이재명 대통령의 국정수행 평가도 동반 하락했다. KSOI 조사에서 이 대통령 긍정 평가는 전주 대비 9.4%포인트 내린 50.4% 였다. 부정 평가는 10.5%포인트 오른 45.7%였다. 이 대통령의 국정수행 지지도의 긍·부정 평가 간 격차가 오차 범위 이내로 좁혀진 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

President Lee, currently on a European tour, shared the poll results on X (formerly Twitter) and stated, "I apologize to the people," adding, "I humbly accept the sober assessment of the citizens." He continued, "I will take a lower stance, be more humble, open up more broadly, embrace more, and work harder." However, Park Seong-hoon, senior spokesperson for the People Power Party, commented in a statement, "With approval ratings falling, this is a belated apology show. What the people want is not a one-line apology posted on social media. True reflection and responsibility are proven through actions, not words." (유럽 순방 중인 이 대통령은 엑스(옛 트위터)에 이날 여론조사 결과를 공유하고 “국민 여러분께 죄송하다”며 “냉정한 국민의 평가를 겸허하게 받아들인다”고 했다. 이어 “더 낮은 자세로 더 겸손하게, 더 넓게 벌리고 더 많이 포용하며 더 열심히 하겠다”고 했다. 그러나 박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 논평에서 “지지율 떨어지니 뒤늦은 사과 쇼”라며 “국민이 원하는 것은 소셜미디어에 올린 한 줄짜리 사과문이 아니다. 진정한 반성과 책임은 말이 아니라 행동으로 증명하는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: South Korean LNG Carrier Transits Strait of Hormuz, Second After HMM Tanker (한국 LNG운반선 호르무즈 해협 통과…HMM 유조선 이어 두번째)
item.description:
South Korean LNG Carrier Transits Strait of Hormuz, Second After HMM Tanker (한국 LNG운반선 호르무즈 해협 통과…HMM 유조선 이어 두번째)

A South Korean vessel that had been stranded inside the Strait of Hormuz since the outbreak of the US-Iran conflict has exited the strait. This marks the second South Korean ship to traverse the Strait of Hormuz, following the HMM oil tanker Universal Winner. (미국·이란 전쟁 발발 이후 호르무즈 해협 내에 갇혔던 한국 선박 한 척이 해협을 빠져나왔다. 한국 선박의 호르무즈 해협 통과는 HMM 유조선 유니버설 위너호에 이어 두 번째다.)

The Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries announced on the 11th, "A second South Korean ship from inside the Strait of Hormuz has passed through the strait." (해양수산부는 11일 “호르무즈 해협 안쪽에서 두 번째 우리나라 선박이 해협을 통과했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs also stated, "The negotiations for this passage were led by the foreign charterer, and we understand that the vessel is heading to a third country, its final destination." A charterer refers to a company that leases a ship for use. (외교부도 “금번 통항 관련 협의 등 사항은 타국적 용선사 측에서 주도해 이뤄졌으며, 동 선박은 최종 목적지인 제3국으로 향하고 있는 것으로 알고 있다”고 했다. 용선사는 배를 빌려 사용하는 기업을 가리킨다.)

This vessel is a liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier operated by a South Korean shipping company, with eight South Korean crew members reportedly on board. (이 선박은 한국 선사가 운용하는 액화천연가스(LNG) 운반선으로, 한국인 선원 8명이 승선 중인 것으로 알려졌다.)

The South Korean ship's transit of the Strait of Hormuz comes about 20 days after HMM's very large crude carrier (VLCC) Universal Winner exited the strait on the 20th of last month. That tanker, carrying 2 million barrels of crude oil, arrived at Ulsan Port the previous day. For the Universal Winner's passage, the government had consulted with Iran. (한국 선박의 호르무즈 해협 통과는 지난달 20일 HMM의 초대형 유조선 유니버설 위너호가 해협에서 빠져나온 지 약 20일 만이다. 200만배럴의 원유를 실은 이 유조선은 전날 울산항에 도착했다. 유니버설 위너호의 경우 통항을 위해 정부가 이란 측과 협의했다.)

As a result, the number of South Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz has decreased to 24. The total number of South Korean crew members in the strait, including those on foreign vessels, stands at 139. (이에 따라 호르무즈 해협에 발이 묶인 한국 선박은 24척으로 줄었다. 해협 내 한국인 선원은 외국 선박에 승선 중인 인원을 포함해 모두 139명이다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said, "We have been emphasizing to Iran the swift and safe navigation of all ships, including ours, in the Strait of Hormuz," and added, "We are continuing to communicate with relevant countries regarding this matter." (외교부는 “우리는 이란 측에 호르무즈 해협 내 우리 포함 모든 선박의 조속하고 안전한 항행을 강조해오고 있다”며 “이와 관련 유관국들과 지속 소통 중”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Military's Defense Security Command to Be Dismantled Over Involvement in Martial Law… Its Three Core Functions to Be Split Up (‘계엄 관여’ 軍 방첩사령부 해체… 3대 핵심 기능 전부 쪼갠다)
item.description:
Military's Defense Security Command to Be Dismantled Over Involvement in Martial Law… Its Three Core Functions to Be Split Up (‘계엄 관여’ 軍 방첩사령부 해체… 3대 핵심 기능 전부 쪼갠다)

On the 10th, the Ministry of National Defense announced the "Plan for the Dismantlement and Functional Reorganization of the Defense Security Command," which involves disbanding the command and transferring its core functions to the newly established Defense Security Bureau, the Defense Security Support Group, and the Ministry of National Defense Investigation Headquarters. This marks the dissolution of the command dedicated to counterintelligence and security, originally founded in 1977 as the Army Security Command, after 49 years. The military aims to complete the organizational restructuring by the end of next month. (국방부가 10일 국군방첩사령부를 해체하고 핵심 기능을 국방방첩본부, 국방보안지원단, 국방부조사본부 등에 나눠 이전하는 ‘방첩사 해체 및 기능 개편안’을 발표했다. 1977년 국군보안사령부로 창설됐던 방첩·보안 전담 사령부가 49년 만에 해체되는 것이다. 군은 조직 개편 작업을 다음 달 말까지 마무리하는 것을 목표로 하고 있다.)

Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek stated during a briefing at the Ministry of National Defense building in Yongsan, Seoul, "I am reporting the 'Plan for the Dismantlement and Functional Reorganization of the Defense Security Command' to overcome the errors of the December 3 illegal martial law and move forward as a true military for the people," adding, "This will be a historic watershed in 'building a military for the people' by restructuring the organization and mission of our military's intelligence agency to ensure it can never again intervene in politics." (안규백 국방장관은 이날 서울 용산 국방부 청사에서 가진 브리핑에서 “12·3 불법 계엄의 과오를 딛고 진정한 국민의 군대로 나아가기 위한 ‘방첩사 해체 및 기능 개편안’을 보고드린다”며 “우리 군의 정보기관이 다시는 정치에 개입할 수 없도록 조직과 임무를 재구조화하는, ‘국민의 군대 건설’의 역사적인 분수령이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung promised to reform the military's intelligence agency (the Defense Security Command) during his presidential campaign. The issue arose from the involvement of some personnel, including former Defense Security Commander Yeo In-hyung, in the December 3 emergency martial law. After the government's inauguration, the Ministry of National Defense's "Civilian-Military Joint Special Advisory Committee" released a recommendation in January to dismantle the Defense Security Command and transfer its core functions. The Ministry's plan largely accepts these recommendations. (이재명 대통령은 대선 당시 ‘군 정보기관(방첩사) 개혁’을 공약했다. 여인형 전 방첩사령관 등 일부 인원이 12·3 비상계엄에 관여한 것이 문제였다. 정부 출범 이후 국방부 ‘민관군 합동 특별자문위원회’는 지난 1월 방첩사를 해체하고 핵심 기능을 이전하는 방첩사 개편 권고안을 발표했다. 국방부 안은 이를 대부분 수용했다.)

According to the dismantlement and reorganization plan announced by the Ministry of National Defense, the core functions of the Defense Security Command—①counterintelligence information, ②security audits, and ③security investigations—will be transferred to separate agencies. The counterintelligence information function will be handled by the newly established "Defense Security Bureau" under the Ministry of National Defense. Although it is essentially the successor to the Defense Security Command, the command has been downgraded to a bureau, and instead of a three-star general serving as commander, a two-star general or a civilian military employee (Grade 2) will head the bureau. Of the approximately 3,000 existing personnel in the Defense Security Command, about half are expected to move to the Defense Security Bureau, and the number of general officers is also expected to be reduced to less than half of the Defense Security Command's seven. <<> Among the security audit functions, defense industry and cybersecurity will be handled by the Defense Security Bureau, while internal military security duties, such as security incidents, will be transferred to the newly established "Defense Security Support Group" under the Ministry of National Defense, with a staff of around 200. The authority to conduct security investigations into leaks of classified information and joint investigative powers during martial law, previously held by the Defense Security Command, will be transferred to the Ministry of National Defense Investigation Headquarters. Approximately 200 personnel from the Defense Security Command's security investigation unit are expected to move to the Investigation Headquarters. The Ministry of National Defense decided to abolish the Defense Security Command's functions of monitoring trends, collecting personnel information and public opinion, and gathering information on military personnel's illegal activities and corruption, calling them "tools for power institutionalization." (이날 국방부가 발표한 방첩사 해체·개편안에 따르면, 방첩사 핵심 기능인 ①방첩 정보 ②보안 감사 ③안보 수사 기능은 서로 다른 기관에 이전된다. 방첩 정보 기능은 국방부 산하에 신설되는 ‘국방방첩본부’가 맡게 된다. 사실상 방첩사의 후신이지만 사령부가 본부로 격하되고, 3성 장군이 맡던 사령관 대신 2성 장군 또는 군무원(2급)이 본부장을 맡는다. 3000여 명이었던 기존 방첩사 인력 중 절반쯤이 방첩본부로 이동하고, 장성도 방첩사(7명)의 절반 이하로 줄어들 것으로 알려졌다.)

The Defense Security Command has served as a "shield" by collecting and deterring information related to subversion of the state, terrorism, espionage operations, and defense industrial spies. Experts are concerned that this "dismantlement and reorganization" could weaken counterintelligence capabilities. Professor Nam Sung-wook of Sookmyung Women's University said, "Counterintelligence can only be successful when security, counterintelligence, and security investigations are seamlessly connected. Splitting them across different agencies makes organic cooperation difficult. It essentially neutralizes South Korea's counterintelligence efforts." (보안 감사 기능 중 방산·사이버 보안은 방첩본부가 담당하고, 보안 사고 등 군 내 보안 업무는 200여 명 규모로 국방부 산하에 신설되는 ‘국방보안지원단’에 옮겨진다. 방첩사가 갖고 있던 기밀 유출 등에 대한 안보 수사 및 계엄 시 합동 수사권은 국방부 조사본부로 이관된다. 방첩사의 안보 수사 인력 200여 명은 조사본부로 이동할 전망이다. 국방부는 방첩사의 동향 조사·인사 정보·세평 수집 및 군인들의 불법·비리 정보 수집 기능은 ‘권력기관화 수단’이라며 폐지하기로 했다.)

The Ministry of National Defense stated its intention to establish a dedicated organization to command and supervise the dispersed counterintelligence, intelligence, and security agencies to coordinate their functions. The name of this dedicated organization has yet to be decided. However, concerns are raised within the military that it is unclear how effectively this dedicated organization will operate, and there is a risk that an organization with more expansive powers than the existing Defense Security Command could become a direct power tool of the Minister of National Defense. A military official commented, "Instead of the Defense Security Command, the Ministry of National Defense Investigation Headquarters is being strengthened. That headquarters has been conducting aggressive investigations for 'insurrection charges.' There is a possibility it could gain even more momentum in framing people for insurrection." (방첩사는 국가 전복, 테러, 간첩 작전, 방산 스파이 관련 정보를 수집하고 억제하는 ‘방패’ 역할을 맡아왔다. 전문가들은 이번 ‘해체 및 개편’으로 방첩 기능이 약화될 가능성을 우려하고 있다. 남성욱 숙명여대 석좌교수는 “방첩은 보안과 방첩, 안보 수사가 물 흐르듯이 연결돼야 성공적으로 이뤄질 수 있는데 각 기관에 쪼개면 유기적인 협력이 어렵다”며 “사실상 대한민국 방첩을 무력화시키는 것”이라고 했다.)

Personnel issues, such as adaptation and promotion, are also anticipated for the hundreds of officers who had been transferred to the Defense Security Command from various branches of the military and will now have to return to their original units due to the dismantlement. A Ministry of National Defense official said, "We will ensure they do not face any disadvantages in post assignments." However, those returning to units unrelated to counterintelligence work are likely to face disadvantages in upcoming promotion reviews for field-grade officers, starting next month. When the Moon Jae-in government dismantled the Defense Security Command's predecessor, the "Military Security Support Command," and reorganized it into the "Military Security Support Command," some officers who returned to their original units took their own lives. (국방부는 분산된 기능을 조율하기 위해 방첩·정보·보안 기관을 지휘·감독할 전담 조직을 신설하겠다는 입장이다. 이 전담 조직의 이름은 아직 미정이다. 다만 전담 조직이 얼마나 효율적으로 작동할지 알 수 없고, 기존의 방첩사보다 비대한 권력을 가진 조직이 국방부 장관의 직속 권력기관으로 변질될 수 있다는 우려도 군 내에서 제기된다. 군 관계자는 “방첩사 대신 국방부 조사본부가 강화되는데 조사본부는 그동안 ‘내란 혐의’에 대한 무리한 조사를 해왔다. 내란 몰이에 더 힘이 붙을 가능성이 있다”고 말했다.)

The Army Security Command, launched in 1977, changed its name to the Army Intelligence Command in 1991 after its civilian surveillance activities were exposed during the Roh Tae-woo government in 1990. The Army Intelligence Command was embroiled in controversy in 2017 during the impeachment of former President Park Geun-hye for drafting documents reviewing the declaration of martial law, leading to its rebranding under the Moon Jae-in government as the Military Security Support Command. Later, following incidents like a leak of North Korean secrets by an active-duty officer, the Yoon Suk-yeol government renamed it the Defense Security Command, citing the need to strengthen counterintelligence capabilities and the organization. (각군에서 방첩사로 전출됐다가, 이번 방첩사 해체로 원래 부대에 복귀하게 될 간부 수백 명의 적응이나 진급 등 인사 문제도 예상된다. 국방부 관계자는 “보직 배치 등에서 불이익을 받지 않도록 하겠다”고 했다. 하지만 방첩 업무와 무관한 부대로 복귀한 이들은 당장 다음 달부터 시작되는 영관급 진급 심사 등에서 불이익을 받을 가능성이 크다. 문재인 정부가 방첩사의 전신인 ‘기무사령부’를 ‘군사안보지원사령부’로 해편했을 당시 기무사에서 전출 전 부대로 복귀한 일부 간부가 스스로 목숨을 끊는 일도 있었다.)

item.title: National Assembly Holds Plenary Session Today... Reports Request for Parliamentary Investigation into Ballot Paper Shortage Incident (국회, 오늘 본회의… 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사 요구서 보고)
item.description:
National Assembly Holds Plenary Session Today... Reports Request for Parliamentary Investigation into Ballot Paper Shortage Incident (국회, 오늘 본회의… 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사 요구서 보고)

The National Assembly will convene a plenary session on the afternoon of the 11th to receive a report on the request for a parliamentary investigation into the ballot paper shortage that occurred during the June 3 local elections. (국회가 11일 오후 본회의를 열고 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태에 관한 국정조사 요구서를 보고받는다.)

Earlier, on the 8th, all 161 lawmakers of the Democratic Party of Korea and all 110 lawmakers of the People Power Party submitted their respective requests for a parliamentary investigation to National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik. (앞서 지난 8일 더불어민주당 의원 161명 전원, 국민의힘 의원 110명 전원이 각각 국정조사 요구서를 조정식 국회의장에게 제출했다.)

According to the Act on Inspection and Investigation of State Administration, once a request for a parliamentary investigation is submitted, the National Assembly Speaker must report it to the plenary session without delay and consult with each negotiating group to determine the committee that will conduct the investigation. The investigation begins when the investigative committee submits an investigation plan, outlining the scope, methods, and timeline of the investigation, to the plenary session for approval. (국감국조법에 따르면, 국정조사 요구서가 제출되면 국회의장은 이를 지체 없이 본회의에 보고해야 하고, 각 교섭단체와 협의해 조사를 할 위원회를 정해야 한다. 조사위가 조사 범위와 방법, 기간 등을 정한 조사 계획서를 본회의에 제출해 승인을 받으면 조사가 시작된다.)

Accordingly, the ruling and opposition parties are expected to enter into detailed negotiations starting this afternoon regarding the scope and methods of the parliamentary investigation. (이에 따라 여야는 이날 오후부터 국정조사 범위와 방식 등을 놓고 세부 협상에 들어갈 것으로 전망된다.)
